title: WPSS/711/2022 of SHAHEEN ANJUM Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 711 of 2022
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. I.D. Paliwal, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Standing Counsel for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner was appointed as Gram
Panchayat Vikas Adhikari in District Pauri
Garhwal.
Since the cadre of said post is District
level, therefore, petitioner applied for change of
cadre to District Udham Singh Nagar. The
matter was referred by Director, Panchayati Raj
to the State Government. State Government
granted permission to change cadre of six
Gram Panchayat Vikas Adhikari, including
petitioner.
Since consequential order has not been
passed, therefore, petitioner has approached
this Court, seeking the following relief:-
"i) Issue a writ order or direction in
the nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondent no. 1 to issue an
order, change the cadre of the petitioner as
per Under Section 27 of the Transfer Act
2017 and pursuant to the recommendation
dated 12.11.2020 and 01.12.2020 an order
be issued, transferring the petitioner from
District Pauri Garhwal to District Udham
Singh Nagar."

Learned counsel for the petitioner
contends that out of six persons regarding
whom, decision was taken for change of cadre,
cadre of four persons have already been
changed. He further submits that inaction on
the part of the Competent Authority to issue
consequential order in respect of the petitioner
is unjust.
Since State Government has already
taken a decision for change of cadre of
petitioner, therefore, in the humble opinion of
this Court, the Competent Authority is required
to issue consequential order.
Having regard to the facts of the case,
writ petition is disposed of with liberty to
petitioner to make representation to the
Competent Authority, within two weeks. If she
makes such representation, decision thereupon
shall be taken as per law, within four weeks
from the date of receipt of representation along
with certified copy of this order.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 25.04.2022
Navin
